verdict.rationale: Ramp documents CSV exports and an open Developer API/OpenAPI spec (174 paths) covering transactions, banking, bills, etc., giving programmatic access to most account data, which supports building an exit/export workflow. However there's no explicit 'export all your data' feature, no documented bulk/GDPR-style full-account export, and no stated guarantee about data retrieval after account closure. Missing for 10: a dedicated full-data-export tool or documented end-to-end account offboarding process, and independent confirmation that all historical data (not just API-exposed resources) can be pulled out.
